g.text: 30b · Stale indexing attempt detection and version fencing
Receive delayed indexing job message (attempt N)
Fetch canonical Reel version and active indexing run token
Query current Reel state and indexing token
Return current Reel version & active run ID
[job token matches current active run token]
[job token is stale (superseded by newer edit or re-index)]
Acknowledge and discard obsolete job message
Fencing prevents zombie background workers from overwriting fresher index data
